template: multiply(group_zscore(subtract(winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_usa}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_chn}, 21), std=4)), industry), subtract(1.5, rank(ts_std_dev(subtract(winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_usa}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_chn}, 21), std=4)), 63))))
idea: 引入波动率调整机制，将价差信号与过去63日价差的时序波动率逆序相乘（低波动区给予1.5倍权重，高波动区降至0.5倍），惩罚不稳定的敞口漂移，奖励稳定的结构性分化。
expression_list: multiply(group_zscore(subtract(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_raw_exp_usa, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_raw_exp_chn, 21), std=4)), industry), subtract(1.5, rank(ts_std_dev(subtract(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_raw_exp_usa, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_raw_exp_chn, 21), std=4)), 63))))
